question.text: Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) was established in 1997 in partnership with which UN body?

answer.text: UNCTAD — United Nations Conference on Trade and Development

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 6, GRI is an international non-profit established in 1997 in partnership with the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) to develop sustainability reporting standards that enhance transparency of economic, environmental and social performance. The Trap: UNDP runs human development index work; UNICEF published the Theory of Change Methodological Brief No. 2 (also cited in Ch 6) but did not co-found GRI; UNCTAD is trade-focused. Cross-Exam Context: V-B MF Foundation references UNEP Finance Initiative (PRI context). XXIII just needs recall of the GRI-UNEP link. Assessor's Pro-Tip: If your SE is FCRA-registered with European donors, a GRI-aligned section in the AIR shortens donor reporting because EU donors often pre-map their DD to GRI.
